query:
SELECT e.id, e.blob_key FROM exports e
           WHERE e.status = 'succeeded'
             AND ((e.kind = 'bulk'
                   AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM export_items i
                               WHERE i.export_id = e.id AND i.participant_id = $1))
                  OR e.case_participant_id = $1)
           ORDER BY e.id
